description_en: Deletes one or more premium Internet bandwidth plans
description_zh: 删除一个或者多个公网精品带宽
kebab_example: aliyun ecd delete-network-packages --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-package-id np-amtp8e8q1o9e40000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteNetworkPackages

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the premium Internet bandwidth plans. You can specify one or more IDs
parameters.help_zh: 公网精品带宽ID列表。可设置一个或者多个
parameters.name: network_package_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of resource ownership in the reseller pattern. This parameter is not required in the non-reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid
